# Auto-Cleanse

> Auto-Cleanse is a Devon-based specialist in diesel particulate filter (DPF) cleaning, ECU remapping and vehicle diagnostics, based at a workshop in Totnes, South Devon. DPF cleaning is carried out off the vehicle at the workshop (with local collection, drop-off and UK-wide postal options); ECU remapping is available at the workshop or as a mobile service across Devon.

Key facts:

- Workshop: The Old Barn Industrial Estate, Webbers Yard, Totnes, Devon TQ9 6JY. Phone: 01803 269895.
- DPF cleaning is a workshop / off-vehicle service, not a mobile service. Mobile visits are for ECU remapping only.
- Diagnostics are a paid service, not free.
- Services genuinely offered: DPF cleaning (collection, drop-off, UK postal), blocked-DPF and DPF diagnostics, ECU remapping (Stage 1 and Stage 2), mobile ECU remapping, economy/van/4x4/fleet remapping, ECU cloning, AdBlue/SCR repair and diagnostics, and a trade ECU/TCU file service for garages and mobile tuners.

## DPF cleaning & diagnostics

- [DPF cleaning](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/dpf-cleaning): off-vehicle DPF cleaning with collection, workshop drop-off and postal options.
- [DPF cleaning near me](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/dpf-cleaning-near-me): how to reach us - drop-off, Devon collection, or UK postal.
- [DPF collection across Devon](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/dpf-cleaning-devon): Devon-wide DPF collection and trade cleaning.
- [Postal DPF cleaning](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/postal-dpf): UK-wide send-in DPF cleaning.
- [Blocked DPF help](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/blocked-dpf-cleaning-devon): warning-light and limp-mode diagnosis and cleaning.
- [DPF diagnostics](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/dpf-diagnostics-devon): paid diagnosis to find the cause before cleaning or replacement.

## ECU remapping & tuning

- [ECU remapping](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/ecu-remapping): Stage 1 and Stage 2 tuning for cars, vans and 4x4s.
- [Mobile ECU remapping in Devon](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/mobile-ecu-remapping-devon): remapping at your home or workplace across Devon.
- [Stage 1 remaps in Devon](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/stage-1-remaps-devon): the most popular software-only upgrade.
- [ECU cloning](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/ecu-cloning): cloning a faulty or damaged ECU onto a replacement unit.

## AdBlue

- [AdBlue & SCR repair and diagnostics](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/adblue-repair-devon): diagnosing and repairing AdBlue/SCR faults.

## Trade

- [Trade ECU & TCU file service](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/trade-file-service): a file service for garages and mobile tuners (Stage 1/2, TCU, DPF, EGR, AdBlue and custom requests).

## Service areas

- [ECU remapping locations](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/ecu-remapping-locations): towns covered for ECU remapping across Devon.
